L-Теанин.about: Green tea amino acid: calm focus and less stress; 200 mg over 30-60 minutes improves attention.
L-Теанин.caution: L-theanine is an amino acid found in tea. A meta-analysis of 31 RCTs showed improved attention and reduced stress. Effect on sleep: Evidence is mixed. Synergy with caffeine is a classic nootropic stack. Safe in standard doses (100-200 mg/day). Does not cause drowsiness. Well tolerated.
L-Теанин.food_sources: Green tea: 5-20 mg per cup - far from effective; for 100-200 mg, concentrated forms are needed.
L-Теанин.guidelines: MA 2026 (31 RCT, 1168): attention SMD 0.51, stress 0.31, fatigue - none. SR 2026 (13, n=550): sleep 200-450 mg. No NYA.
L-Теанин.how_to_choose: Pure L-theanine 100-200 mg; with caffeine 2:1 for focus; without “sleep formulas”; as needed.
mechs: Modulation of glutamate, increase in EEG alpha rhythm
Stress reduction in stressful conditions (200-400 mg/day)
Relaxation without sedation: support onset and sleep quality
Falling asleep, maintaining sleep and feeling restored (200-450 mg/day)
L-Теанин.myths: “Theanine = tea” - 5-20 mg per cup, not 200. “Leds to sleep” - relaxation without sedation. “Treats anxiety” - modest, significant in 1 work.
L-Теанин.name: L-Theanine
L-Теанин.onset: Acutely: 200 mg over 30-60 minutes - better attention (SMD 0.51); sleep - course, 200-450 mg/day.
L-Теанин.title: L-Theanine
L-Теанин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
L-Теанин.who_needs: Mental work under stress; “Jitter-free focus” (caffeine 2:1); sleep support 200-450 mg; anxiety - weak.
